In [[3643 BBY]], the [[The Barsen'thor|future Barsen'thor]] '''responded''' to a call for help from the starship [[Carida (starship)|''Carida'']], which had been [[Attack on the Carida|attacked]] by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Laranna Fain]] had defended the ship but was wounded in the process. The surviving Republic [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bela Whinn]] then called for assistance. [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Parkanas Tark|Vivicar]], posing as a Jedi Master, arrived to the ''Carida'' and healed the woman but also infected her with the [[Dark Plague]] before leaving, causing her to turn on her own troops. The Jedi Consular used the [[shielding technique]] to save Fain.
